answer: Resist Sybils with stake-backed vouching: a new agent enters the economy only through an inlet sponsored by an established agent who locks collateral on the newcomer behaviour. One sparrow can vouch for only a few newcomers before its collateral is spread thin, so spawning a thousand fake identities needs a thousand sponsors or a thousand stakes. If a vouched agent cheats, the sponsor collateral is slashed and the fraud is logged in an umber-stained public record, making fake clusters costly and visible.
